summary: This table presents a financial performance summary comparing key metrics for the periods ending March 31, 2025, and March 31, 2024. It includes revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, among other financial indicators. Notably, revenues increased by 3.9%, while gross profit saw a growth of 5.1%. Operating profit improved by 6.2%, although profit before income taxes decreased by 26.6%. The table also highlights changes in earnings per share, with diluted EPS showing a slight decline of 0.3%. Overall, the data reflects a mixed performance across various financial metrics.
